data.title: Speeding fine of €98.50 (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.summary: The City of Musterau fine office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice for exceeding the speed limit by 23 km/h outside built-up areas on 2 September 2026. The total is €98.50 and 1 point in the driving aptitude register (Fahreignungsregister).
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h is allowed. The fine is €70.00, plus €25.00 fees and €3.50 expenses, and 1 point is entered in the register. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fine office; the app shows until when. Be aware that an objection can lead to a less favourable decision. If you do not object, the notice becomes final and you must pay within two weeks after it becomes final. Consider professional advice if you want to contest it.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against fine notice
items.action: If you disagree, file a written objection or one recorded at the fine office (Bußgeldstelle).
items.consequence: The notice becomes final and enforceable. An objection may also lead to a less favourable decision.

date.text: innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung

items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50
items.action: Pay the total to the fine office's account, quoting the file number, within two weeks after the notice becomes final.
